# requirements-lock.txt — the exact dependency set CI and the daily bot install
# (Linux x86_64, CPython 3.11). Every package is pinned, so the environment that
# renders the public site is the one tests.yml tested. torch comes from the
# PyTorch CPU index (no CUDA stack); xgboost is the xgboost-cpu build.
#
# Do not edit by hand. After changing requirements.txt / requirements-dev.txt:
#   uv pip compile requirements-dev.txt -o requirements-lock.txt \
#       --python-version 3.11 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#       --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu \
#       --index-strategy unsafe-best-match --emit-index-url --no-annotate --no-header
#   (then re-add this header, and pin torch to a +cpu build if it resolved otherwise)
# Install:  pip install -r requirements-lock.txt
--index-url https://pypi.org/simple
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
